title: Coffee Frappuccino
subtitle: Coffee syrup and condensed milk blitzed with ice into a thick, slushy café frappé.
protein: ~3g protein per glass — from condensed milk

method.label: Toddler — her glass (no coffee)
items: Pour {@milk:toddler} into her cup; frappés are all coffee, so plain cold milk is her version

method.title: Blend
items: Blend on high until thick, smooth and slushy, with no ice chunks left
Pour into a chilled glass and serve at once

method.title: Make it yours
items: Taste before pouring; add a little more condensed milk for a sweeter frappé
Add a splash of water if the blender struggles
For a richer, creamier frappé, blend in a splash of cold milk too

method.label: Tip
method.text: Ranveer Brar's card lists only ingredients; the method here is built around them. A good blender makes the texture — pulse a few times first to break the ice, then run it on high.
